2609.17464.title: Decomposition Buys Integrity, Not Yield
2609.17464.paper_summary: Multi-agent systems split a task across a tree of agents and justify the split with folklore: smaller contexts, cleaner separation, parallelism. We ask what the split does to how much of what the leaves discover reaches the root. Model a decomposition as a tree in which an agent handed $b$ items keeps any one with probability $r(b)$. If $r(b)=1/b$, every tree delivers exactly one finding, for every task size and every shape; we verify this to $2.4 \times 10^{-15}$ on 20,000 random irregular trees. If $r(b)=Cb^{-δ}$, a depth-$k$ tree over $N$ findings yields $C^k N^{1-δ}$: task size and architecture separate, and architecture contributes only $C \le 1$ per level, so flat is optimal for yield and no arrangement of agents escapes the exponent $δ$. On 600 production deep-research traces $δ= 0.34$ [0.30, 0.38], by three identifications that do not share a failure mode. At a hop where item boundaries come from the tool rather than a text heuristic, and where $b=1$ occurs 550 times, $C = 0.571$ [0.527, 0.615] is observed rather than extrapolated, over 16,082 hops. A tier also costs alignment: on 1,012 annotated multi-agent traces one brief in sixteen goes off-target, giving $μ= 0.939$ and a per-tier penalty $Cμ= 0.536$. Depth is bought on two other axes. The root context is the only state that persists and the only one that cannot cheaply forget, and depth cuts its exposure from $N$ items to $N^{1/k}$. Depth is also cheaper: production flat agents bill as $N^{1.39}$, not the $N^2$ an append-only context predicts, and at equal spend two tiers overtake flat at 403 findings. Across every parameter we measured the model says 0.7% to 11.3% of production sessions are worth delegating, against 7.8% that do. A hazard model on 743,819 production tool calls finds that delegation does not respond to a filling context and is instead an opening move.
2609.17464.paper_summary_zh: 多代理系統將任務分配到一棵代理樹上，並用民間傳說來證明這種分割：較小的上下文、更乾淨的分離、並行性。我們詢問這種分割對於葉子所發現的內容有多少能夠到達根部的影響。將一個分解建模為一棵樹，其中一個代理交付 $b$ 項目，以概率 $r(b)$ 保留任何一項。如果 $r(b)=1/b$，則每棵樹對於每個任務大小和每個形狀都恰好提供一個發現；我們在 20,000 個隨機不規則樹上驗證了這一點，精度達到 $2.4 \times 10^{-15}$。如果 $r(b)=Cb^{-δ}$，則一棵深度為 $k$ 的樹對於 $N$ 個發現產生 $C^k N^{1-δ}$：任務大小和架構是分開的，架構每層僅貢獻 $C \le 1$，因此平坦的結構在產出上是最佳的，且沒有任何代理的安排能逃脫指數 $δ$。在 600 個生產深度研究的追蹤中，$δ= 0.34$ [0.30, 0.38]，這是通過三個不共享失敗模式的識別得出的。在一個項目邊界來自工具而非文本啟發的跳躍中，且 $b=1$ 出現 550 次，觀察到 $C = 0.571$ [0.527, 0.615]，而非外推，這是在 16,082 次跳躍中得出的。一層也需要對齊成本：在 1,012 個註釋的多代理追蹤中，每十六個簡報中就有一個偏離目標，給出 $μ= 0.939$ 和每層懲罰 $Cμ= 0.536$。深度在其他兩個軸上也有成本。根上下文是唯一持久的狀態，也是唯一無法便宜忘記的狀態，而深度將其暴露從 $N$ 項目削減到 $N^{1/k}$。深度也更便宜：生產平坦代理的計費為 $N^{1.39}$，而不是附加上下文預測的 $N^2$，在相同支出下，兩層超越平坦結構，達到 403 個發現。在我們測量的每個參數中，模型顯示 0.7% 到 11.3% 的生產會話值得委派，而實際上只有 7.8% 這樣做。對 743,819 次生產工具調用的危險模型發現，委派並不響應填充上下文，而是一種開場動作。
